quizzes.title: Boundaries
quizzes.hook: How easily do you protect your time, energy and limits?

low.title: The Accommodator
low.description: You often make room for other people first and may tolerate more than you actually want to.

mid.title: The Flexible Boundary
mid.description: You can adapt for people you care about while still recognizing when a limit needs to be stated.

high.title: The Gatekeeper
high.description: You are comfortable protecting your time, energy and standards even when saying no creates temporary discomfort.

quizzes.title: Adaptability
quizzes.hook: What happens when reality ignores your plan?

low.title: The Stabilizer
low.description: You work best when expectations stay consistent and prefer enough time to adjust when circumstances change.

mid.title: The Recalibrator
mid.description: Change can disrupt you briefly, but you usually rebuild a workable plan once you understand the new situation.

high.title: The Shape-Shifter
high.description: You pivot quickly when conditions change and often treat new constraints as information rather than disruption.

quizzes.title: Competitiveness
quizzes.hook: Does comparison sharpen you or barely matter?

low.title: The Self-Pacer
low.description: You care more about your own standard and enjoyment than beating someone else.

mid.title: The Friendly Rival
mid.description: Competition can add energy without defining the whole experience, especially when stakes remain healthy.

high.title: The Challenger
high.description: A visible benchmark or rival can unlock extra focus, effort and satisfaction for you.

quizzes.title: Patience
quizzes.hook: How well do you tolerate waiting, repetition and slow progress?

low.title: The Fast Mover
low.description: You prefer visible movement and quick feedback, and slow processes can drain your attention fast.

mid.title: The Practical Waiter
mid.description: You can tolerate delay when the reason is clear, but unnecessary waiting still tests you.

high.title: The Long-Gamer
high.description: You are relatively comfortable with delayed rewards, repetition and progress that takes time to become visible.

answers.text: Continue if the process is sound

quizzes.title: Independence
quizzes.hook: How much do you prefer figuring life out on your own?

low.title: The Co-Pilot
low.description: You naturally think with other people and often make better decisions through shared input and support.

mid.title: The Selective Soloist
mid.description: You value autonomy but know when another perspective, skill or hand makes the outcome better.

high.title: The Solo Operator
high.description: You strongly prefer self-direction and usually try to solve things independently before involving anyone else.
